verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents Graph Explorer, a vendor-hosted interactive console for Microsoft Graph (Entra's API surface). It lets you run real API calls anonymously against a sample tenant or your own tenant, and it provides code snippets and permission discovery. Coverage is partial: the runnable experience is a separate, client-rendered console scoped to all of Graph rather than Entra, and the evidence does not show the API reference pages themselves embedding runnable examples. missing for 10: evidence that the reference docs (e.g. user-list) carry inline runnable examples, an Entra-specific interactive reference, independent or hands-on corroboration that Graph Explorer works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Graph Explorer is a developer tool for exploring Microsoft Graph APIs
